title: Add a validated ISBN field end to end
difficulty_rationale: A new field must flow consistently through the model, serializer, versioned JSON storage (with a v1 to v2 migration), validation and query layers of a five-module package, following existing conventions.
summary: Add an optional, checksum-validated ISBN-13 to books across models, serialization, storage (schema v2 with v1 migration) and the API layer.
required_behavior: Book gains an optional isbn field (default None) stored in normalised 13-digit form.
api.create_book and api.update_book accept isbn; hyphens and spaces are stripped; invalid ISBN-13 checksums or formats raise ValidationError.
ISBNs are unique across the library; duplicates raise ValidationError.
Serializers include isbn; storage writes schema_version 2 and loads both v1 (no isbn, treated as None) and v2 files.
api.list_books(isbn=...) filters by normalised ISBN; other existing filters keep working.

acceptance_tests.description: Duplicate ISBNs are rejected on create and update.
update_book can set and clear the ISBN.
Saving writes schema_version 2 with isbn; loading round-trips.
v1 files load with isbn None and are re-saved as v2.
list_books filters by ISBN in any accepted format.
